motor.name: MG310 1:20 Hall encoder
motor.listing: seller listing (owner, 2026-11-13): 1:20, rated 7.4 V, rated 0.4 kgf.cm at 400 rpm +/-13 %, rated current <= 500 mA, stall 1.5 kgf.cm, stall current '<= 2 mA' (typo, read as 2 A)

assumptions.i_stall: ASSUMPTION 2.0 A at 7.4 V: the listing says '<= 2 mA'; the listed torques give 1.9 A at efficiency 0.6
assumptions.i_no_load: ASSUMPTION 0.12 A, typical for a 7.4 V 310-size motor; measure at bring-up
assumptions.j_rotor: ASSUMPTION 1.0e-6 kg m^2 (310-size rotor); measure by spin-down
assumptions.inductance: ASSUMPTION 1.0 mH; measure with an LCR meter
assumptions.encoder_ppr: ASSUMPTION 13 pulses per motor revolution (common for MG310 Hall encoders); count at bring-up
assumptions.no_load_rpm: derived: straight torque-speed line through (rated torque, 400 rpm) and (stall torque, 0)

criteria: worst case over gear efficiency 0.5-0.65 and VBAT 9.9-12.6 V: recover 10 deg within 1 s; >= 20 deg recoverable (the search stops at 34 deg); cruise voltage at 1.0 m/s <= 70 % of the cap; recommend the lowest passing cap (closest to the motor rating), then the lowest passing trip
